sloka: संपृष्टेन तु वक्तव्यम् सचिवेन विपश्चिता ।उद्यत अंजलिना राज्ञे य इच्छेत् भूतिम् आत्मनः ॥३-४०-९॥
transliteration: saṁpṛṣṭena tu vaktavyam sacivena vipaścitā ।udyata aṁjalinā rājñe ya icchet bhūtim ātmanaḥ ॥3-40-9॥

translations.english: A wise counsellor should give advice to the king only when his opinion is sought and that too with folded hands, if he wishes his own prosperity.
